title: National Sugar Cookie Day: Top 10 bakeries for cookies in western Massachusetts - NewsBreak
text: CHICOPEE, Mass. (WWLP) – Wednesday, July 9th is National Sugar Cookie Day! Sweet tooths in western Massachusetts have plenty of reasons to join in, especially with the region’s standout bakeries offering some of the most crave-worthy cookies around. From time-tested traditional recipes to modern twists with local ingredients, these 10 bakeries have earned high ratings and reviews for their cookie offerings. Whether you’re a fan of buttery sugar cookies, chewy chocolate chip, or creative seasonal flavors, we have compiled a list of the 10 highest-rated and most reviewed bakeries throughout the region. Here are the top 10 bakeries in western Mass.: Whether you’re craving a sweet and classic treat or branching out into something new, these local bakeries are delivering the goods. Be sure to visit one or all 10 and sample the best that western Massachusetts has to offer.
